messages.text: v2.4 is out! We've added SSO via SAML, fixed the thing where exports timed out, and you can't use the old /v1/reports endpoint anymore. Please don't forget to update your integrations ASAP!!

Draft changelog for 2.5:
- Added bulk-delete for saved filters
- Fixed: dashboard widgets were not refreshing after a timezone change
- Changed: API rate limit raised from 60 to 120 requests per minute
- Removed: legacy CSV export (use the new export API)

replies.text: Can we get the PR links on each line? Needed for the notes.
Sure: bulk-delete #412, widgets #418, rate limit #420, CSV #409.

messages.text: Customer asked how to reset an API key. Answer I gave: Go to Settings, then API, click the key, hit Rotate. The old key stops working right away so you gotta update your scripts first or they'll break. Don't worry, it's super easy!

replies.text: Third time this week. Someone should write this up.

messages.text: Webhook retries: we retry 5 times over 30 minutes. After that the event is dropped and shows as Failed in Settings > Webhooks > Deliveries. Customers keep asking where to see this.
Correction: retries are 8 over 2 hours since 2.3. The Deliveries page is right.
